scientific_integrity: Analytic derivation of moments and weak limit; direct exact enumeration is a cross-check, not an infinite proof; priority remains subject to external verification.
scientific_limitations: Binary independent uniform source; exactly two disjoint bursts of length two; distinct-output sphere count. The result does not address nonbinary or nonuniform sources, more bursts, or optimal code sizes. The proof uses the published canonical-history theorem; independent validation is not performed.
title: Exact variance and Gaussian fluctuations of binary two-burst deletion spheres
